upright.short: Sensitivity, inspiration, emotional openness, intuition, pleasant news.
upright.general: The Page of Cups symbolizes emotional curiosity, intuition, creativity, and openness to new experiences. This card often points to pleasant messages, inspiration, romantic interest, or the beginning of emotional growth. It also reflects youthful sensitivity and imagination.
upright.in_love: A new romantic interest, flirting, emotional sincerity, or a gentle expression of feelings. The card may indicate the beginning of a tender relationship or emotional reconciliation.
upright.in_situation: The situation develops through intuition, flexibility, and emotional openness. Unexpected opportunities or pleasant emotional experiences may appear.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today may bring pleasant surprises, emotional news, creative inspiration, or the beginning of new feelings. Stay open to intuition and sincere emotions.
upright.card_advice: Trust your heart, remain emotionally open, and do not be afraid to express kindness, curiosity, and creativity.

reversed.short: Immaturity, emotional confusion, unrealistic fantasies, insecurity.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Page of Cups may indicate emotional immaturity, unrealistic expectations, insecurity, or avoidance of responsibility. A person may be overly sensitive or lost in fantasies.
reversed.in_love: Misunderstandings, emotional instability, childish behavior, or unrealistic romantic expectations. Feelings may not be sincere or mature enough.
reversed.in_situation: The situation may involve emotional confusion, unreliable information, or lack of direction. It is important to remain realistic and emotionally balanced.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today may bring emotional confusion, unrealistic expectations, or disappointing news that challenges your emotional balance. Misunderstandings or insecurity could make it difficult to trust your intuition clearly.
reversed.card_advice: Stay grounded and avoid reacting impulsively to emotions or fantasies. Honest self-reflection, emotional maturity, and realistic thinking will help you navigate uncertainty more wisely.
